card.name: Just before drug names starting with P
card.fires_on: Positions right before a drug or chemical name beginning with P or similar sounds, such as a capital P at the start of a name, or a comma or 'include' leading into a list. Also partway through morphine and quinine.

modes.label: Start of a P-name
modes.description: A lone P begins a drug name or a sentence about prolonged use.

modes.label: Link before a drug list
modes.description: A comma, 'include' or 'and' leads into the next named drug or compound.

modes.label: Inside morphine or quinine
modes.description: The pole fires on the first piece of the word, as in morph- or qu-.

card.plain: It fires just before a drug name, such as promethazine or morphine, is about to appear in a list.
